$comment: Authored port of the hand-written registry group appconfig-experiments (docs/plans/compat-coverage-modelgen.md §3.11, G6 wave 3, #1116, #2244). The group had one native implementation, in the cli suite (compat/suites/cli/internal/groups/appconfig.go); the other six suites carry it as parity debt, 3 rows each, which the port closes. It is the port that needed the java-sdk BOM bump (#2244): ListExperimentDefinitions, ListExperimentRuns and ListExperimentRunEvents first appear in AWS SDK for Java v2 2.46.18. It soaked as appconfig-experiments-shadow beside the cli native until the nightly comparison (run 38990424807) found none of its 21 (suite, test) pairs diverged in any of three soak runs; the flip then renamed it to appconfig-experiments, pointed the hand-written registry entry at it and deleted the native code. The experiment surface is not implemented by Overcast and its definitions cannot be created (there is no CreateExperimentDefinition in the registry group), so, as the native does, the three tests only exercise the collection URIs with the deliberately nonexistent identifier zzzzzzz; an unimplemented operation reaches the harness as `unimplemented`, not `fail`. The group has no setup and no teardown: it creates nothing. The native asserts only that the response carries an Items member; there is no documented effect to read back, since every operation is a read of a collection nothing here creates. Every scenario backend signs with AppConfig's own credential scope, as the cli native does.

groups.$comment: Three independent list calls with no shared state, in the registry's order. Like every authored port it is a lifecycle group, and with no setup and no teardown it creates nothing.
groups.name: appconfig-experiments

tests.$comment: The native lists the experiment definitions of the nonexistent application zzzzzzz and asserts the response has an Items member (a page, empty or not). Carried whole, as two clauses because a path carries one check: `present` is the native's presence check, which holds for an empty page where nonEmpty would fail it and fails an omitted Items, and `isList` says that what is there is a list.
tests.name: ListExperimentDefinitions

tests.$comment: The native lists the runs of experiment definition zzzzzzz in application zzzzzzz and asserts an Items member, carried as present and isList for the reason ListExperimentDefinitions states.
tests.name: ListExperimentRuns

tests.$comment: The native lists the events of run 1 of experiment definition zzzzzzz in application zzzzzzz and asserts an Items member, carried as present and isList for the reason ListExperimentDefinitions states. Run is the model's PositiveInteger, so it is the number 1 where the native's CLI flag is the string "1".
tests.name: ListExperimentRunEvents
